Name: Transparent Underwear (For Use With Other Mods)
Author: DrakeKiller101
Description:
I just quickly determined which of the clothes where the base "underwear" of the female character and made them transparent in order to use a "nude mod", or similar type of mod, while still being able to use the base clothing and not having everything transparent. Will likely do nothing on it's own without some type of edit to the "farmer_girl_base.xnb" file. Again I have done minimal testing, so I am not sure what this will do without any other mods.

Just replace the concurrent files that are already in ~~~\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer with the files provided and should work no problem.
Also, cannot have any other files or mods that overwrite these, or the files contained inside (Pants/Shirts.png), else the mod will not work. You either need to modify those files or mods manually to make them compatible or uninstall the mod entirely. I will never make a compatibility patch of any sort with any mod for this file, mainly because, at least as far as I am aware, it would be impossible to do so.

Only tested, as of now, with patch 1.4.5 as it is the most recent to my knowledge and only with the Steam version.

Disclaimer: Not the greatest with editing files as this is the first time that I have actually bothered to do so myself, so there will more then likely be some stuff that does not work properly or is off and needs to be fixed. In such cases, I will do my upmost to fix it, though I have no intention of editing any of the male files, as there is very little probability that I will be able to test them myself.
-Moreover, any damage done to the game files while you modify them are not my responsibility, as I have given all the information I can for a smooth install process.

Downloads.Description: Seem to have removed more "clothes" then I should have. I seem to have removed the bare minimum with this file, as before, if anything is left, I will do my best to find and remove it without interfering with the normal clothes.
